messages:
lucas: quick q — for /v1/generate if input has an unsupported param (e.g. top_k but model doesn't accept it), do we return 400 or 422? also what shape should the error JSON be?

maria: i'd vote 400 for invalid request shape/unknown params, 422 for semantically invalid (like prompt too long) — but both are client errors. 5xx only for server failures.

sam: agreed. threw in a suggested error payload in the last PR:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_parameter",
    "message": "Unknown parameter: top_k",
    "param": "top_k",
    "retryable": false
  }
}
```

nora: minor thing — include a machine_readable code (e.g. INVALID_PARAM) at top-level for client logic. Also confirm HTTP status 400.

lucas: ok so 400 + error.type/ code + retryable flag. what about rate limit vs capacity transient errors — 429 vs 503?

kevin: 429 for rate limiting (client hitting quota/rl), 503 for transient infra capacity (gpu OOM, node unavailable) — in 503 we should surface retry-after when possible. set retryable=true for 503, false for 4xx.

infra-bot: deploy: canary rollout of api-contract change to /v1/generate scheduled at 11:30. monitor: error-rate and 5xx spikes.

maria: code review note @sam — make sure the SDK maps UNKNOWN_PARAM -> InvalidParameterError (no retry).

sam: on it. also adding a small compatibility rule: if clients send unknown params but pass a header X-Allow-Unknown=true, we will ignore unknown params and proceed (for back-compat). still log a warning.

lucas: that's great — lets document that in the spec. one more: validation errors vs schema mismatch. if body fails JSON schema (malformed JSON) -> 400 with message 'malformed_json', if schema valid but value invalid (negative temperature) -> 422 with 'validation_error'?

nora: yes — recommended mapping:
- 400: malformed JSON, unknown top-level fields, missing required fields
- 422: semantic validation (out-of-range params, incompatible combinations)
- 429: client rate limits/quota exhausted
- 503: temporary infra / capacity / overloaded (retryable)
- 500: unexpected server error (retryable but try with exponential backoff)

kevin: add standard header X-Error-Code for quick routing in infra logs, and Retry-After for 429/503 when possible.

maria: can someone add a short section to api_contract.md with examples and the exact JSON shape? i can copy the sample above.

sam: i'll open a tiny PR after lunch. tagging @kevin for header names. any objections to using "code" vs "type" in payload?

lucas: prefer "code" (machine) + "message" (human) + "details" array optional. fine if both exist but keep one canonical.

nora: final check — backward compatibility: keep old error fields for 6 months but mark deprecated. clients should prefer new fields.

lucas: excellent. will draft the spec update and post here. thanks all :thumbsup:
